fields.summary: The availability monitor of alderbank-production-web failed 6 polls in a row between 03:10 and 03:40 UTC; the search page returned HTTP 503 while the heapgauge alarm fired on the search cluster.
The availability monitor of brightmoor-nginx failed 2 polls at 11:05 UTC and recovered on its own; no service was reported down.

fields.description: Monitor reported alderbank-production-web down for 30 minutes.
fields.rca: Root cause: the search cluster ran out of heap (heapgauge above 95 percent) after a bulk reindex; the node was restarted and the reindex throttled.

fields.description: Monitor reported brightmoor-nginx down twice; recovered without action.

fields.what_happened: Search for alderbank returned HTTP 503 for 30 minutes.
fields.root_cause: A bulk reindex exhausted the search cluster heap; the heapgauge alarm fired and the node stopped answering.
fields.fix: Restarted the node and throttled the reindex job.

title: Pattern: search cluster out of heap

fields.symptom: Search returns HTTP 503 and the heapgauge alarm fires.
fields.likely_cause: A bulk reindex or a large aggregation exhausts the search cluster heap.
fields.first_checks: Check the heap gauge, running reindex jobs and recent mapping changes.
